declarations.name: ShowBonus
declarations.doc:
Bonus.unity's entities, while a player has them: the match loads the scene, and Unity loads it with them. Twice:
the scene again beside it, which Unity loads another of

fields.name: board
fields.doc: A cell for each line said

declarations.name: Say
declarations.doc: A line from Unity's UI, which the match keeps for everyone: TideRunner.Get<Extras>().said in C#

declarations.name: Crowd
declarations.doc: Balls nobody rolls, as many as asked for: what a busy match costs Unity each frame (ScaleTests)

declarations.name: Toss
declarations.doc:
A ball nobody rolls, in and out of the box: a GameObject made and let go of as its entity comes and goes, which
TideRunner's pool keeps for the next

declarations.name: Trail
declarations.doc: A ball's trail, which a prefab sets in Unity's inspector as any struct field

declarations.name: Ball
declarations.doc: Each player's ball, which Tide rolls and Unity shows (Roller.prefab)

fields.name: heard
fields.doc: This machine's, as its local handler counts its bounces (Heard)

declarations.name: Bounced
declarations.doc: A ball hitting the floor: C# hears it as local handlers do (TideRunner.On, OnVerified, the ball's TideEntity.On)

declarations.name: Paint
declarations.doc: Sent to a ball: TideRunner.Send(new Paint { ... }, ballGameObject) in C#

declarations.name: Badge
declarations.doc:
A render target Tide draws into, shown at the top right (yellow over its top left, green elsewhere), and stencil:
a circle storing 1 where it is, and a cyan square drawn only there

declarations.name: Depths
declarations.doc:
A multisampled target's depth, which Unity resolves to one sample a pixel for a frag to read: a cube drawn into it,
its depth shown at the bottom left, darker where the cube is nearer than the far limit
